summary: Coach hub in one block: run book on a clipboard, the three clearance steps (JDP email, yearly training, no certificate), schedule tiles, gear bag rules, rules and field layouts; the All-Star link opens the same 2026 PDF as the All-Stars page.
blurb: One place for coaches: the run book, clearance steps, schedules, gear and rules.

sources.fact: Spring volunteers get the background check emailed automatically by JDP and must also complete Abuse Awareness Training with the same email.
Abuse Awareness Training is required and valid for the year; no certificate needed, use the email you registered to volunteer with.
Coaches return team gear to the Daffodil Shed at the end of the season (Fall 2026: Sat Nov 7).
Gear return rules: gear cleaned, keys on the zipper.
